technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall have satisfactorily completed (90% of the contract value) as a prime contractor at least one similar work as mentioned in PQR criterion 1, of value not less than Rs.9.75 lakhs in any of the preceding 5 years (2021-22,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26). The bidder should furnish satisfactory work done Certificate issued by Chief Engineer or Equivalent (Work done of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited).

The Bidder should have minimum average annual turnover of Rs.19.5 lakhs in any two years during the preceding 5 years (2021-22,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26). As a proof of turn over the bidder should furnish Profit & Loss Account / Turn over certificate duly certified by the Chartered Accountant (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited).
